Conflicts and Killings Map

Land and environmental defenders killed, threatened and attacked across the world; violence against Indigenous peoples in Brazil; and the threats, murders, massacres and land conflicts the Pastoral Land Commission records across rural Brazil. Each case is at the place its source gives, with the source's own record in its box.

Time

Fromto

Records with no year are always shown. Each row's year is the source's: the date of the killing or event, or the year of the table or report that lists the case. Under each row you can choose what its dots are coloured by and keep only some of its records.

How dots are drawn

Filled dot: at the place the source gives (exact coordinates, or a town or municipality) Ring: the source names only a province, state or country; drawn at that area's middle Shaded country or municipality: darker for a higher figure

Where several records share one spot, they are drawn slightly apart in a small spiral so each can be clicked; each box says so. Where dots still overlap at a zoom, a click lists every one under it.
